input.risks:
1. DEFAULT VALUE IS THE ONE REAL JUDGEMENT CALL. The current radar layout is counter-clockwise on screen (proved by `y = cy - coord*sin(angle)` in `coordToPoint` combined with `+idx*2PI/n`). I recommend `clockwise: false` as the default so existing charts and all visual/screenshot baselines are untouched, matching the requirement's "without breaking ... the rest of the radar rendering contract". This deliberately DIVERGES from the `clockwise: true` default used by `pie` (`src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts:220`), `gauge` (`src/chart/gauge/GaugeSeries.ts:209`), `sunburst` (`src/chart/sunburst/SunburstSeries.ts:227`), `chord` (`src/chart/chord/ChordSeries.ts:308`) and `angleAxis` (`src/component/polar/install.ts:43`). If consistency with those is preferred, the only edit is `clockwise: false` -> `clockwise: true` in `RadarModel.defaultOption` — but that flips every existing radar chart and will invalidate radar screenshot baselines.

2. Sign convention is easy to get backwards: `dir = clockwise ? -1 : 1` (NOT `+1`), because the Y axis is inverted in `coordToPoint`. Getting this wrong produces a chart that looks plausible but is mirrored.

3. `this.clockwise` must be assigned in `resize()` before the `each(this._indicatorAxes, ...)` loop; `resize()` is called from the constructor (`src/coord/radar/Radar.ts:76`) and is the only place angles are set, so there is no second call site to keep in sync.

4. `clockwise` must stay out of `RadarModel.optionUpdated()`'s merge into `InnerIndicatorAxisOption` (`src/coord/radar/RadarModel.ts:135-151`); leaking it into the per-indicator axis model would put an unknown key on `AxisBaseOption`.

5. `Radar.pointToData`'s `Math.abs(radian - angle)` comparison is not wrap-safe at +-PI (see findings). Not caused by this feature, but `clockwise: true` shifts which indicators sit near the seam, so tooltip axis picking may look newly flaky if left unfixed.

6. Reversing indicator order reverses the winding of the splitArea polygons in `src/component/radar/RadarView.ts:164-172`. Verified harmless for the ring-band fill it constructs, but it is the one rendering path whose output geometry ordering changes, so it is the place to look first if a fill artifact appears.

7. No documentation lives in this repo (option docs are in the separate echarts-doc repo), so there is no in-repo doc file to update; the TS interface comment is the only user-facing description.
